title: Today in Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on the biggest stories across golf today.

items.headline: Si Woo takes control
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 16-under after going 9-under through 12 holes.

items.headline: Bryson rumor answered
items.text: A PGA Tour pro denied a rumor about Bryson DeChambeau, saying the claim about players’ feelings toward him was false.

items.headline: Round 2 is set
items.text: Friday tee times are out for the CJ CUP Byron Nelson, with the leaders positioned for the early cut-line and weekend chase.
